services.desc: The 5’4 LIFT5 Cruiser is the most stable, forgiving, and beginner-friendly board in Lift’s Gen5 lineup - designed for relaxed rides, easy takeoffs, and smooth touchdowns. Whether you’re just learning, cruising the bay, or sharing the ride with family and friends, this setup makes it easy to get up and love every minute on the water. With the all-new Lift Connect System (LCS) and drop-in Gen5 battery, this eFoil delivers simplicity, safety, and performance in one super-smooth package. Note: LCS Jet uses more power than a folding prop. Ride time varies based on speed and rider weight.
